title: OpenAI · 博客来源更新
summary: Added API key creation governance controls at the organization and project levels. Administrators can allow only service-account keys, allow only user-owned project keys, or disable all new API key creation. Organization restrictions take precedence over project settings, and existing API keys are unaffected. See production best practices for details.
